summary: Part 2 of the KAM onboarding walkthrough (03:57 to 07:05). Pierre fills in a test seller record in the Revibe Seller Onboarding App (AppSheet, Users Form side panel): he answers the 'know anyone who sells' question with Yes and enters BAUTISTA TRADING LLC, opens the DocuSign-hosted Revibe Seller Agreement, uploads a test file (seller_info_form_1.html) in the signed-agreement field, answers Yes to the quality guidelines question, completes the legal documentation section (trading license number 12345, tax certificate, ID, position CEO / Founder, bank details, DHL No), then shows the application status change from Application incomplete to Under review. He then shows the Profile list (Under Review tab, 25 records), where the account manager and supply team check the seller's details, address, seller page and documents, and the admin-only Approval field.
